name: Software Factory
author: Simple Software Factory
description: GitHub issues and pull requests involving your bot account, and the agent sessions working on them: what each agent is doing, what it last said, and where its workspace is.

barWidget.description: A dashboard of the factory: whether the service runs, which bot is signed in, the watched repositories and the agent working each, and the agent sessions (state, last message, activity) with click-through to GitHub or the workspace. Setup is done from the CLI.
